hints.title: CREATURES OF THE DEEP
hints.text: Four kinds of creature live down here, and a touch from any of them is fatal. Each has a weakness. Head east along the gallery.

hints.title: CAVE BAT
hints.text: A bat hangs in the hollow ahead. Bats fly fast and hunt by sight, but they cannot dig. When it wakes, do not stop: dig on under the boulder.

hints.title: SHUT OUT
hints.text: The boulder fell in behind you and blocks the tunnel. A bat cannot get past rock, earth or a boulder - and a falling boulder crushes one. Take the copper and go down the shaft.

hints.title: CAVE SPIDER
hints.text: A blind spider sits at the far end of the tunnel below. It feels digging and blasts up to 15 tiles away, but not footsteps. Walk - cutting through a web is quiet too.

hints.title: ONE LOUD DIG
hints.text: The earth plug at the bottom of this shaft is the only way on. The spider will feel you dig it and come to look - slowly. Dig, drop through and keep going.

hints.title: MINE SNAKE
hints.text: Below, a snake lies coiled to the west. It ignores you until you come close - then it strikes fast, and it follows for as long as you stay near. Keep your distance: the silver is to the east.

hints.title: SEAL THE SHAFT
hints.text: Anything below can follow you up this shaft. Walk round behind the boulder - the gold lies there - and push it into the shaft mouth: the way is shut, and a creature underneath is crushed (+100).

hints.title: CRYSTAL CRAB
hints.text: Take the dynamite. In the cave below waits a crab: falling boulders bounce off its shell and it eats through earth, but it is very slow. Walk round it, or blast it (press 1).

hints.title: WELL HUNTED
hints.text: Bats, spiders, snakes, crabs: you have met them all. Take the iron, then cross the crab's cave to the exit hatch in its far corner. Next lesson: water, ice and lava.
